sample_jds.title: Senior ML Engineer
sample_jds.jd:
We are hiring a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join our AI Platform team.

Requirements:
- 5+ years of experience in Python, TensorFlow or PyTorch
- Strong background in building and deploying production ML systems
- Experience with AWS (SageMaker preferred) and Docker/Kubernetes
- Familiarity with MLflow or similar MLOps tooling
- Proven track record with recommendation systems or NLP applications
- Strong SQL skills and experience with large-scale data

Role type: Senior Individual Contributor
Location: Bangalore / Remote

sample_jds.title: NLP / GenAI Engineer
sample_jds.jd:
We are looking for an AI/NLP Engineer with expertise in Large Language Models.

Requirements:
- 3-6 years of experience in NLP or Generative AI
- Hands-on experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar RAG frameworks
- Proficiency in Python and HuggingFace Transformers
- Experience with vector databases (Pinecone, FAISS, Chroma)
- Familiarity with OpenAI API or GROQ
- FastAPI for model serving

Role: Mid-Senior NLP/GenAI Engineer

sample_jds.title: MLOps Engineer
sample_jds.jd:
MLOps / AI Platform Engineer

Requirements:
- 4-7 years of experience in DevOps or MLOps
- Strong Python skills with Airflow or similar orchestration
- Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform expertise
- GCP or AWS cloud platform experience
- MLflow or similar model registries
- CI/CD pipeline design
